faq.q: What is the seawater corrosion rate of Titanium Subsea Battery Clamp Ring?
faq.a: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V exhibits a general corrosion rate of <0.01 mm/year in quiescent seawater and <0.05 mm/year in high-flow (5 m/s) seawater. Unlike stainless steels, Titanium Subsea Battery Clamp Ring is immune to chloride stress corrosion cracking and pitting corrosion up to 260°C. For subsea battery pod in submerged service, no cathodic protection is required — a significant cost advantage over steel and aluminum.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Subsea Battery Clamp Ring?

Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for subsea battery pod.
